method: Read-only recovery from frozen SemInv event archives, results.json fuzz individuals, local PoC Solidity sources, and stored Foundry replay logs. No test, fuzz, replay, compilation, RPC, or network command was run.

archived_end_to_end_runtime.interpretation: Total end-to-end analysis duration from the case ledger; event discovery time is separately recovered from raw error.time.

source_version_reconciliation.scope_note: This verifies the current local Solidity file against the September replay manifest, not against a source snapshot embedded in the original SemInv run directory.

poc_linked_dynamic_invariant_witness.time_origin: Raw results.json error.time, measured from SemInv execution_begin immediately before engine.run; case statistic takes the earliest qualifying witness in each case.
poc_linked_dynamic_invariant_witness.matching_rule: Same selected contract, normalized PC, and normalized detector type; trigger_tx_index must select an individual transaction whose selector uniquely decodes to a function declared in the local PoC Solidity source; that function name must occur in the archived event function_sequence. Test roots, helpers, and callbacks are included.
poc_linked_dynamic_invariant_witness.path_granularity: Top-level transaction prefix through trigger_tx_index; this is the SemInv fuzz input dynamically executed to the event, not internal EVM call-edge coverage.

source_level_path_recovery.interpretation: Supplementary source-derived overlap only. The primary witness metric above does not exclude test roots and does not depend on static callgraph reachability.

reference_path_availability.foundry_replay_command_records_are_quiet: Per-case forge.log artifacts use `forge test ... -q`; the saved logs do not include runtime call trees.

limitations: The recovered sequence is the SemInv fuzz individual's dynamically executed top-level transaction prefix through the recorded invariant trigger. It is not the original DeFiHackLabs PoC transaction sequence and does not encode internal EVM call edges.
The primary linkage establishes an observed SemInv invariant witness at a uniquely decoded PoC-declared entrypoint; it is not, by itself, a profit-oracle reproduction result.

Stored SemInv reproduction validation refers to replay of the SemInv finding under its own validation pipeline; it does not establish that the original DeFiHackLabs profit/state oracle was reproduced.
Legacy Strong/Partial/Uncovered fields are retained only for provenance and are not used to compute the objective path metrics.
